Descr:
We invite nonprofit leaders to join the GAC and BVU for a new quarterly roundtable experience.  Throughout this series, you will experience the power of coming together to gain expert insights, build connections, and explore shared pain points, experiences, and solutions.  Each session will provide expert content, alongside opportunities for structured discussions and open networking. 

Join us for From Firefighting to Focus: Practical Tools Every Nonprofit Leader Can Use to Lead More Strategically, presented by Lisa Lazarus.

This workshop will focus on community-building to strengthen leaders' capacity, leveraging time strategically, and investing in staff development/bench-building. We'll begin with introductions that help people see one another as resources and partners and then discuss tools leaders can use to ensure they are focusing on the things only they can do in their role.

 

This event is specifically for Nonprofit CEOs and senior leadership.

EventName: Small Business Lunch and Learn - September
Descr:
We invite you to join us for the September Lunch and Learn, part of the Small Business Program event series featuring events and resources aimed at supporting the growth and success of small businesses in Greater Akron.  Held monthly, each event features a speaker on a topic of relevance to small businesses.  During this event, attendees will have the opportunity to connect with each other through networking, hear a presentation on a relevant topic, and engage in conversation with the featured expert through Q&A.  

Lunch will be provided.

Space is limited.

The September Lunch and Learn will feature Josh Muller, Founder of Maple Creek Coaching, speaking on The Pinch Point: The 9 places business owners get stuck in the business they built, and the 9 moves that get the business flowing again.

Join us as we partner with Ratliff and Company to bring you Generations in the Workplace, facilitated by Aneta Ardelian Kuzma and Tuck Sweeney. 

The workforce and your customers have evolved, and the way you lead must change to meet the challenge. In this dynamic session, we will explore how generational needs and unconscious bias are quietly shaping every hiring decision, team meeting, and customer interaction in your business. You will learn how to spot the patterns in your own leadership that may be costing you talent, trust, and growth — and walk away with the language and tools to build a more inclusive workplace. Lead and partner more confidently across generations and turn the unique mix of people in your business into your greatest competitive advantage.

EventName: ACAA: Ohio TechCred Program Updates Webinar
Descr:
In partnership with the Ohio Department of Development, the Akron-Canton Advocacy Alliance invites you to a webinar focused on relevant updates and new information on Ohio’s TechCred Program. After months of anticipation, TechCred will reopen on October 1, and this webinar will serve as a prime opportunity to learn about new rules, updated procedures, and areas of focus. All those who RSVP will receive relevant meeting materials and have the opportunity to submit questions for presenters.

This event is closed to the media.

 

For Questions Regarding the event: Please contact John Rizzo, jrizzo@akroncantonadvocacy.org
